title: Divide-and-Conquer Neural Bayes Estimation for Spatial and Spatiotemporal Point Process Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27619v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial and spatiotemporal point process models are widely used to analyze event data across many scientific disciplines, but likelihood-based Bayesian inference is often computationally prohibitive due to intractable likelihoods, high-dimensional latent structures, and dependence on event history. Existing approximate and likelihood-free methods mitigate some of these challenges, but often at the cost of reduced statistical efficiency, imperfect uncertainty quantification, or information loss from reliance on predefined summary statistics. A promising recent approach involves neural networks, but it has only been explored in purely spatial or temporal settings and requires a computationally expensive training stage for large domains or dense point patterns. translated_title: 面向空间与时空点过程模型的分治式神经贝叶斯估计
translated_abstract: 空间与时空点过程模型被广泛应用于多个科学领域的事件数据分析，但由于似然函数难以处理、潜在结构维度过高以及推断依赖事件历史等原因，基于似然的贝叶斯推断在计算上往往难以承受。现有的近似方法和无似然方法虽能缓解其中部分挑战，但往往以统计效率降低、不确定性量化不完善、或因依赖预定义汇总统计量而造成信息损失为代价。近期一种有前景的方法利用了神经网络，但此前仅在纯空间或纯时间场景中被探索，且对于大范围区域或稠密点模式，其训练阶段计算代价高昂。本文提出了一种针对空间与时空点过程模型的分治式神经贝叶斯估计框架，该方法直接在原始点模式实现数据上进行操作……
tldr: 本文提出一种分治式神经贝叶斯估计框架，可直接在原始点模式数据上高效推断空间与时空点过程模型，克服了传统贝叶斯方法中似然难处理与计算昂贵的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a divide-and-conquer neural Bayes estimation framework that operates directly on raw point pattern data, enabling efficient inference for spatial and spatiotemporal point process models while overcoming the intractable likelihoods and computational costs of traditional Bayesian inference.
